description: Auto Review hooks: opt-in UserPromptSubmit arming and Stop-driven review/fix loop

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,runpy,sys; roots=[os.environ.get('CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT'),os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'),os.getcwd(),os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'plugins','auto-review')]; script=next((os.path.join(r,'hooks','auto_review_hook.py') for r in roots if r and os.path.exists(os.path.join(r,'hooks','auto_review_hook.py'))),None); sys.exit(0) if script is None else runpy.run_path(script, run_name='__main__')"

python3 -c "import os,runpy,sys; roots=[os.environ.get('CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT'),os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'),os.getcwd(),os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'plugins','auto-review')]; script=next((os.path.join(r,'hooks','auto_review_hook.py') for r in roots if r and os.path.exists(os.path.join(r,'hooks','auto_review_hook.py'))),None); sys.exit(0) if script is None else runpy.run_path(script, run_name='__main__')"
